author: mark
text:
Redesign conversation-repo layout; retire invocation as structural term

Substantial rewrite of ARCHITECTURE.md §2 and touch-ups through §3, §4, §5,
§6, §7, §8, §10, §12, plus carried terminology cleanup in PRINCIPLES.md and
a lernie-specific stance note added to TAXONOMY.md.

Terminology:
- "Conversation" is now the structural primitive (root + subagent share
  shape).
- "Invocation" retires as a structural term.
- "Exchange" demotes to UX label.
- "Soul" added to the terms table.

Layout:
- Control files move from .agent/ to the conversation-repo root, outside all
  worktrees.
- Worktree invariant made explicit: everything inside a worktree is composed
  into the prompt.
- Sibling worktree layout: root/ for the primary, hyphenated-descent names
  for subagent worktrees.
- merge=ours for goal.md, soul.md, summary/**; steps namespaced by
  conversation id for collision-free merge.

Skills/tools: skills copied into worktree on load; descriptions committed on
main and inherited.

Providers: global (endpoint/auth) vs per-repo (role -> model pointer) split.

Milestones: v0.4 renamed "Invocations" -> "Subagent dispatch"; v0.3 criterion
extended to cover the layout migration; v0.1/v0.2 historical descriptions
preserved.

No code changes; implementation lands in downstream balls.
